baselinePopulationDefinition.choice: cad_property at each county's DECLARED vintage per lib/cad-ingest/src/vintage.ts DECLARED_CAD_VINTAGES -- the exact table+filter the conformant bake itself reads (fetchCountyCadPropertyRoll), not a flat all-vintage scan, and not place_layer_snapshots (which retains stale/retired rows and would conflate 'ever served' with 'currently a live account').
baselinePopulationDefinition.rationale: The dispatch's own three source findings (CTX-RETIRE's 48055:1, CTX-ACREAGE's 48491:PRIVATE ROAD, CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's 38,060 geometry-only Hays rows) were each found by querying a specific vintage or an anti-join across vintages -- none established whether the instance was in the CURRENTLY SERVING roll or a superseded one. That is the first thing this lane must settle before counting, because a family member that only exists in a retired vintage is a different disposition question (already-retired, no customer-facing exposure) than one sitting in the live roll today.

c1_badPropIdShape.sourceOfTruth: inverse of isParcelShapedPropId, lib/cad-ingest/src/txgio/landuse.ts:113-115 -- the fleet's own existing definition of a parcel-shaped id (bare-numeric or Williamson's R-account form), added by CTX-LEAVES2 as a forward-looking ingest guard. This lane applies the same rule as a measurement, not a guard.

c2_txgioBucketId.sql: per (county_fips, prop_id) in txgio_parcel, feature_count = count(*) via GROUP BY (never a flat join, per the dispatch's own stated trap); a 'bucket' is a prop_id whose feature_count is an outlier far above the ordinary 1-3 features a real multi-tile parcel carries
c2_txgioBucketId.thresholdApproach: Not assumed -- histogram the full feature-count distribution across all 6 counties first (bucket boundaries 1 / 2-5 / 6-20 / 21-100 / 100+) and pick the threshold from the observed gap, matching CTX-RETIRE's own worked values (203, 227) which sit far above any plausible legitimate multi-tile count.

c3_punctSitusNoSignal.sql: situs_address ~ '^[\s,.\-;:''"`]+$' AND assessed_value IS NULL AND (exemption_codes IS NULL OR cardinality(exemption_codes)=0) AND living_area_sqft IS NULL
c3_punctSitusNoSignal.sourceOfTruth: situs regex is serveGuards.ts:10 PUNCTUATION_ONLY_RE verbatim (confirmed byte-identical against the live file before use); 'no other CAD signal' operationalized as CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's own calibrated three-field recovery signal (assessed_value, exemption_codes, living_area_sqft), reused rather than invented, so criterion 3 and criterion 4 are comparable on the same signal definition and their co-occurrence is measurable rather than an apples-to-oranges comparison.

c4_stratmapNoSignal.sql: source_file ILIKE '%stratmap%' AND assessed_value IS NULL AND (exemption_codes IS NULL OR cardinality(exemption_codes)=0) AND living_area_sqft IS NULL
c4_stratmapNoSignal.sourceOfTruth: CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's own pre-registered-and-fired-clean recovery signal, reapplied here to the CURRENT declared vintage of all 6 counties rather than only a 2025-to-2026 anti-join population -- this generalizes the shape CTX-HAYS-SPLIT scoped to one county's dropout population to the full live roll of all 6.

coOccurrencePlan: A single 4-flag contingency table (GROUP BY all 4 boolean predicates) over the union of the 6 counties' declared-vintage rows, plus the same breakdown per county, answers directly whether criteria co-occur, nest, or are independent -- read off the table rather than asserted from four separate percentages.

predicateControl.design: Run the identical 4 predicates against 3 non-CTX Texas counties already used as a control population by a prior lane in this same fleet (48027, 48113, 48439 -- CTX-ACREAGE's own control set, reused for consistency rather than picking a fresh one) at their own current declared vintage. A control that returns all-zero would mean the predicates are dead code; a control that returns implausible near-100% on every row would mean a predicate is not discriminating.
predicateControl.note: This control also functions as an important CAVEAT surfaced during measurement, not just a pass/fail gate -- see falsifierOutcome below.

preRegisteredFalsifier.statedBeforeRunning: If c1 (bad-propid-shape) returns near-zero on ALL SIX target counties at their current declared vintage, that would mean CTX-ACREAGE's single 48491:PRIVATE ROAD instance is not a live, currently-served defect but a historical one already superseded by a later vintage -- a materially different, better finding than 'this family is live and uncounted.' This must be checked directly (is PRIVATE ROAD's row's tax_year equal to 48491's declared 2026, or an earlier one?) rather than assumed from the aggregate count.
preRegisteredFalsifier.secondFalsifier: If running c1 against a non-CTX control county returns a large nonzero count, the specific matched values must be inspected before treating the control as a clean discrimination proof -- a large hit could mean the predicate is firing on a DIFFERENT county's legitimate, non-sentinel account-numbering convention rather than on real garbage, which would make the control support 'the predicate can fire' but NOT support 'the predicate reliably discriminates garbage everywhere.'

outOfScopeConfirmed: No write, delete, or correction to any row (every connection this lane opens sets default_transaction_read_only=on before any query)
No weakening of PUNCTUATION_ONLY_RE or assertSitusNotPunctuationOnly -- not read for editing, only reproduced verbatim as a measurement predicate
No deploy, Cloud Build, Cloud Run job, bake, publish, or walk execution -- every check against a served payload (if any) is a plain HTTP GET
No write to hauska-factory, hauska-engine, or hauska-map
No sampler tuning -- this lane does not touch selectSweepParcels/selectJurisdictionCohort or any hauska-factory file at all
